title: Base images (ship-fleet image ls --json, version 1)
description: Printed on stdout by `ship-fleet image ls --json` on the FleetLedger computer: the baked images (contracts/image.md) as ships.toml records them, the one new Ships start from, and each driver set up there with the images a new Ship on it can start from (what `ship-fleet new --driver --image` takes). Read from ships.toml only: it asks no Ship and no hypervisor. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

pinned.description: What new Ships start from unless `new --image` says otherwise (defaults.image, `ship-fleet image use`): an image id, or stock (the driver's own template).

ubuntu.description: The Ubuntu cloud image build it was baked from.

tooling.description: The ShipShape tooling version baked in.

dirty.description: Baked from a checkout with uncommitted changes.

recipes.description: The catalogue recipes whose system parts are baked in.

published.description: Where it is ready to clone from, per driver (e.g. proxmox: {template_vmid: 9181}).

ships.description: How many Ships in the inventory were made from it.

file.description: Its qcow2 is still kept on the FleetLedger computer.

drivers.description: The drivers a new Ship can be made with there, in this order: manual always, proxmox once ships.toml has [drivers.proxmox]. Which one `new` uses without --driver is `ship-fleet defaults --json`'s driver.

images.description: What a new Ship on it can start from: stock first, then each image published to it, by id.

imageId.description: e.g. 26.04-20261102-3f9a1c2e: Ubuntu release, bake date, first 8 hex of the bake inputs' hash.
